_comment: Closed idea-space families from the recorded kills (graveyard.json holds the numbers; this holds the KINSHIP descriptions a decision model judges against). A family's scope is what the kill record or signed prereg closed, in the plan's own language. Maintained as kills accrue.

risk_adjusted_momentum.description: Cross-sectional momentum rankings on this universe, plain or risk-adjusted (return divided by own volatility), ANY lookback — nearby lookbacks are the same family. H1/H3: IC negative at 9 of 9 horizons (pooled t -6.1), top quintile worst of five.

lowvol_rank.description: Long-only low-volatility / stability level rankings on this universe, any volatility measure, window or rebalance scheme. Closed PERMANENTLY by signed prereg: rank IC was real (t 5.0, 7/7 folds) and the monetization lost 33.4% at ZERO fees.

distance_from_highs.description: Proximity-to-trailing-high rankings (breakout proximity, 52-week-high anchoring), any lookback or entry/exit hysteresis. Killed at the S2 estimate gates: the monetizable edge is too thin for its costs in any per-trade accounting that doesn't borrow beta.

short_term_reversal.description: Cross-sectional short-term reversal rankings (recent losers bounce) on ~weekly lookbacks. Failed the measured factor screen: right sign at h1 but t 1.1 — a lean, not a signal.

volume_shock.description: Cross-sectional abnormal-volume / attention rankings (recent volume vs its own baseline). Failed the measured factor screen in the registered battery.

breadth_regime_gate.description: Market-LEVEL regime timing of the whole basket — breadth gates, risk-on/off overlays, any market-wide on/off exposure switch. Structurally dead on this universe's history: ~20 completed regime episodes vs thousands needed at the noise floor; a timing book has no cross-sectional multiplicity.

cemd_trend_reversion.description: Cross-sectional reversion toward an ADAPTIVE trend anchor (causal EMD trend, adaptive moving averages, filtered fair values) — snap-back-to-filter readings. IC statistically zero at every horizon with valid calibration.

trend_voltarget.description: Single-pair trend following with volatility-targeted position scaling. Cost coverage -0.04x at default parameters.

kalman_spread_reversion.description: Market-level spread / state-space mean reversion (Kalman-filtered pairs or baskets) with sparse episode counts. ~90 trades available vs 2,400 needed at sd 15pp on a 21-day hold.
